name: zclass_cls_di_segments_recursive

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x446440 validates the enabled/raycastable/stop-after-first/variant gates, node flag clearing, class dispatch, object matrix-push cases, LOD/sequence gates, camera/animate/light delegation, active-mask local copies before frustum tests, FilterRegionsAgainstPolygon calls, child recursion, break-on-first behavior, sound truthy return, and unknown-class error return.
